# Entity One

> > Entity One is an event management and conference organization company specializing in digital technology conferences and business events across Mumbai and New York.

Entity One delivers comprehensive event planning, conference management, and PR services with expertise in speaker coordination, digital technology summits, and corporate gatherings. The company maintains offices in Andheri West, Mumbai and serves clients globally with a portfolio of successful international conferences and business events.
